claims.statement: Tom Allen failed to put in an appearance at Chicago on December 11, 1882, to post the preliminary forfeit for a championship prize fight with James Elliott.
claims.excerpt: Allen failed to put in an appear

fights.excerpt: Allen failed to put in an appear
fights.notes: Forfeit by Allen: he did not appear to put up the preliminary forfeit.

notes: Same event as 670 and 672, reported in a city-news column.
